hypothesis: With fast experts (QWEN36_FAST_EXPERTS=5) and the MTP head's drafts, keeping a token's middle-rank experts only when the expert cache holds them or the layer before guessed them reads fewer experts from the SSD, so the 32 decode steps after a 512-token prompt of chat.txt, the first included, get faster on an 8 GB M1, both versions fed the same tokens (teacher forcing), at a quality cost that is measured and stated.
model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration) converted to Colibri's qwen36 container: INT4 routed experts with gs=64 group scales, f16 dense weights (quantized to INT8 at load) and f16 embedding; 23 GB of safetensors; canonical.qc beside it (1.94 GB, written by qwen36-canonical) and experts.qc (17.1 GB, scales as 16-bit codes, the bytes qwen36-canonical --experts writes: its records written on 2026-10-05, its 8-byte stamp on 2026-10-07); the checkpoint's shards were written on 2026-09-16; and model-mtp.safetensors (the checkpoint's MTP head: the 529 tensors tools/convert_qwen36.py --mtp-only writes, byte for byte, read from a file of 531,710,984 bytes written on 2026-10-06, SHA-256 c8a3779f7e95016f923d3686663061621ac0ab1d221dc677e0f8869357a1a4ac; docs/experiments/qwen36-mtp-speculative-2026-10-06/head.txt)
command: git archive f4eb8f75 c | tar -x -C <dir>, make -C <dir>/c qwen36_metal.o backend_metal.o METAL=1, then from the repository root, with the compiler flags make -C c qwen36 METAL=1 gives qwen36.c except its qpack path (-DQWEN36_QPACK and its objects, which the harness does not use): clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -I<libomp>/include -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-unused-function -DCOLI_METAL -DQWEN36_METAL -I<dir>/c docs/experiments/qwen36-fast-guessed-2026-10-14/bench.c <dir>/c/qwen36_metal.o <dir>/c/backend_metal.o -o <dir>/qwen36-bench -lm -L<libomp>/lib -lomp -framework Metal -framework Foundation -framework Accelerate -lc++; every run: /usr/bin/time -l env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$HOME SNAP=<model+head> TEACHER=1 launchers/<variant>/qwen36-bench chat.txt 64,512 32; <variant> is pr13-fast5 for the baseline (launchers/pr13-fast5/qwen36-bench, a script with the one line QWEN36_FAST_EXPERTS=5 exec bin-pr13/qwen36-bench "$@") and pr13-guessed4 for the trial (QWEN36_FAST_EXPERTS=5 QWEN36_FAST_GUESSED=4 exec bin-pr13/qwen36-bench "$@"); the runs used 082ce6c2, a local commit not in the repository whose c/ tree is f4eb8f75's (the branch moved onto a later record of the commits below, with the same c/ tree)

hardware.cpu: Apple M1, 4 performance + 4 efficiency cores (MacBook Air, MacBookAir10,1, no fan)

config.SNAP: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Colibri qwen36 container, INT4 experts gs=64, internal SSD, with the checkpoint's MTP head in model-mtp.safetensors
config.BUILD: the compiler flags of make -C c qwen36 METAL=1 on macOS without its qpack path: clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -DCOLI_METAL -DQWEN36_METAL, qwen36_metal.o and backend_metal.o
config.EXPERT_CACHE: the Metal graph's default: a sixteenth of the RAM (512 MiB, 303 slots of 1.77 MB, the head's experts among them)
config.PROMPT: the first 64 and the first 512 tokens of chat.txt (in this record: an English conversation written for these measurements, plain User:/Assistant: text without the chat template, 6,900 bytes read whole; prompt_hash is its SHA-256), each from an empty state; after each, 32 tokens, each fed the text's own next token (teacher forcing: both versions read the same tokens)
config.ORDER: 1 warm-up run (baseline, discarded), then baseline trial trial baseline baseline trial trial baseline, one process each
config.REST: thermal state nominal, then 60 s, before every run
config.EXPERT_SOURCE: experts.qc beside the model; the head's experts from model-mtp.safetensors
config.ENGINE: the Metal graph, default (fast) kernels with QWEN36_FAST_EXPERTS=5 and the MTP head's drafts
config.QWEN36_FAST_GUESSED: unset: fast experts' rule, a token's five likeliest routed experts and the rest of its top-8 only when the expert cache holds them
config.MEASURED: tokens per second of all 32 decode steps after the 512-token prompt, the first included: 32 / (gen_first_ms / 1000 + 31 / gen_steady_tps), from the harness's columns; each step fed the text's next token (teacher forcing), with the MTP head's drafts

quality.method: Correctness: both versions were fed the same tokens (teacher forcing: the hash of the tokens is the same in every run of both), and without the variable this commit's exact-mode logits are its parent's (fingerprints.txt). The quality cost is measured, not gated: over 1024 teacher-forced tokens of this text after a 64-token prompt (quality.txt), R = 4 changes the mean negative log-likelihood by -0.23% (standard error 0.70%; perplexity -0.3%) and the share of tokens the model ranks first by -0.1 points (standard error 0.6). Fingerprints (baseline / trial), each the same in every run of its version: 64 tokens 3a93397be9cf8da3/f55beb9e5e71ac78 / 307e6fd7980a92cf/f55beb9e5e71ac78, 512 tokens 4b20073f783cf97c/99b2135657766012 / 9d70cb5e1eb455e0/99b2135657766012.
